# 1 Clement Chapter 65 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 65 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_065_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 65

*[Final Greetings and Dispatch of the Letter-Bearers]*

**65:1** Now send back our messengers to us speedily — Claudius Ephebus and Valerius Bito, together also with Fortunatus — in peace and with gladness, so that they may the more promptly report to us the peace and concord that we pray for and long to see, and that we in turn may the more quickly rejoice over your good order.

**65:2** The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you and with all in every place who have been called by God through him; to whom be glory and honor, power and greatness, and eternal dominion, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
